name: cavemio-thinking-trace
title: Thinking trace
description: An expandable record of what an agent did: steps, reasoning, search or tool calls.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The header is a button with aria-expanded. A status region beside it announces the label and then the summary ("Thought for 6s"), never the ticking timer.
- Collapsed rows are inert, so links inside a folded trace can’t be tabbed to.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the sweep, spinners, rolls and row entrances stop; the trace still opens and closes.
- Long labels and file paths truncate instead of wrapping.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: steps
props.description: – · Rows so far: label, plus optional detail, href, icon, status, additions and deletions.

props.name: status
props.description: "done" · The state of the whole trace.

props.description: – · Start time in ms. Shows a live timer and times the done label.

props.name: duration
props.description: – · How long it took in ms, if your stream reports it.

props.name: label / doneLabel
props.description: – · Override the running and settled headers.

props.name: query
props.description: – · Search query shown above the sources.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange

useCases.title: Reasoning models

useCases.title: Agents with tools
useCases.description: A record of searches, file reads and tool calls.

useCases.title: Research assistants

features.title: Steps arrive as your stream reports them
features.description: Rows are added as they come and the list eases taller to make room.

features.title: Four ways to draw the rows
features.description: Plain steps, reasoning text, search results with sources, or tool calls with file changes.

features.title: It folds into a summary
features.description: “Thinking 6s” becomes “Thought for 6s”, and the trace folds into that one line.

features.title: Failures stay visible
features.description: On error it stays open, shows “Couldn’t finish” and marks the step that failed.

features.title: Rows can link or act
features.description: Rows can carry a link, or call onStepClick, for example to show a tool’s output.

features.title: Open state you control
features.description: Leave it automatic, or control it yourself. Folded rows are inert so links inside can’t be tabbed to.

states.title: running
states.description: A 1.4s sweep of light crosses the header and its seconds roll up once a second; the trace is open, the live step spins and the list eases to each new height (420ms).

states.title: done
states.description: The header morphs to a summary, "Thought for 6s" (the timer stays as the answer) or "Ran 3 tools" (the timer folds away), and the trace folds shut 900ms later. The last spinner blurs into a check that draws itself.

states.title: error
states.description: The sparkle blurs into a red alert and the header morphs to "Couldn’t finish"; it stays open with the failed step’s mark turned to a red cross and "Failed" opening beside it.

states.title: cancelled
states.description: "Stopped", for when the user stops the agent.

states.title: step: pending / running / done / error
states.description: Each row can carry its own status, e.g. a queued step or one tool call that failed.
